svg.title: Figure 43.2 — Healthy Brood Versus Early AFB Suspicion
svg.desc: Comparison of coherent healthy sealed worker brood versus early AFB-suspicion pattern with irregular sealed brood and some sunken/perforated cappings.
svg.text: Figure 43.2 — Healthy Brood Versus Early AFB Suspicion
Compare the pattern, then individual cappings and remains; early AFB can be subtle.

text.tspan: Pattern supports investigation but does not prove AFB. Differentials include EFB, sacbrood, chilled brood, queen problems and
